name: PT Oxala Energy International Tbk
summary: PT Oxala Energy International Tbk engages in the production and sale of polymer vinyl chloride (PVC)-based plastic in Indonesia. The company offers PVC pipes, HDPE pipes, Rubicon PVC fittings, PVC glue, PVC gutters, casting buckets, and other accessories. It serves the industry, trade, construction, services, transportation, agriculture, printing, and workshops sectors. It was formerly known as PT. Multi Makmur Lemindo and changed its name to PT Oxala Energy International Tbk in August 2026. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
